note: What a server sends about the points a champion can choose to return to life at. A client acts on it only where its screen has a panel of such points. The header carries zero.

fields.name: action
fields.note: What happened. A client ignores any other value.

0.name: owned
0.note: The point is now held by side, at the position given.

1.name: chosen
1.note: The player named by clientId chose the point.

fields.name: point
fields.note: Which point.

fields.name: side
fields.note: The side holding it, 100 or 200. It takes effect only where action is owned.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id of the player who chose it. It takes effect only where action is chosen.

fields.name: x
fields.note: Where the point stands, in world units. It takes effect only where action is owned.

fields.name: y
fields.note: Its height, in world units. It takes effect only where action is owned.

fields.name: z
fields.note: Where the point stands, in world units. It takes effect only where action is owned.
